as_told.title: Soviet crash retrievals revealed in opened KGB files

plain: This story is about a journalist, George Knapp, who is said to have travelled to Russia in the 1990s and come back with files on Soviet UFO activity. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it briefly. A physicist, Eric Davis, adds more. He says that when the Soviet Union fell, the KGB, its secret police and spy agency, opened up its files. According to Davis, Knapp and others went there and found a set of papers called the Thread Three documents, which he says show Russia had its own crash retrievals. If true, it would mean another superpower was also recovering unknown craft.
